# Promilla

> Promilla is a free, private drink journal for Android, iPhone and the web. You log what you drink, follow an estimate of your evening and build streaks of alcohol-free days. Everything stays on your phone.

Key facts:

- Made by Venueve AB, Sweden. Contact: hello@promilla.se.
- Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
- No data collection: no tracking, no server. Drinks are saved on the device. Backup files and CSV export are made by the user.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play), iPhone (App Store, coming soon) and a web app at https://app.promilla.se that works offline. The app is in English.
- The estimated level comes from the Widmark formula: grams of alcohol ÷ (r × weight in kg), with r = 0.68 for men and 0.55 for women, falling by 0.15 ‰ per hour until it reaches zero. Drinks count in full as soon as they are logged.
- It is an estimate, not a measurement, and not a breathalyzer. Never use it to decide whether you can drive.
- A standard drink is 12 g of pure alcohol. Users set a weekly target in standard drinks.
- An alcohol-free day is a day with no drinks logged. Days roll over at 05:00. Milestones at 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 90 alcohol-free days in a row.
